name: Palia – Fish
description: The fish of Palia, by location, with normal and starred variants.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle
Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Albino Eel
items.description: An eel with no pigmentation. Found in Bahari Bay caves using worms.

items.name: Alligator Gar
items.description: A carnivorous fish with brilliant purple scales, the Alligator Gar is named after its long snout and rows of large teeth. Found in Kilima Lake using glow worms.

items.name: Amber Moray
items.description: The Amber Moray primarily consumes other river creatures who have become tainted by echo. Perhaps it likes the taste? Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highlands at night.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Ancient Cloudminnow
items.description: A legendary minnow that was previously only known in legend. Found in clouds... allegedly.

items.name: Ancient Fish
items.description: These fish are as old as the continent of Palia itself, and were thought to be extinct. Guess you have something in common.

items.name: Ancient Koi
items.description: Legends say these koi once lived in the ponds of King Mudan's palace.

items.name: Angelfish
items.description: Be not afraid.

items.name: Bahari Bass
items.description: A bountiful, staple fish known for its mild flavor. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay without bait.

items.name: Bahari Bream
items.description: These fish are widely considered to be a staple of the local diet. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using worms.

items.name: Bahari Pike
items.description: A pike with a deep green hue native to Bahari Bay. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Barracuda
items.description: A vicious saltwater predator that tastes great lightly grilled with a little butter. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay without bait in the evening and night.

items.name: Bat Ray
items.description: An ominous ray that is known to leap out of the water like a flying bat. Found in Bahari Bay caves using worms.

items.name: Beluga Sturgeon
items.description: A large sturgeon that grows throughout its entire lifetime. Found in Kilima Lake using glow worms.

items.name: Black Sea Bass
items.description: Known for the black spots on their skin, these bass are gentle and non-threatening to Majiri and humans alike. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using glow worms.

items.name: Blobfish
items.description: A bloated, slimy fish that lives at the bottom of cavern pools. Found in Bahari Bay caves using glow worms.

items.name: Blue Marlin
items.description: A large and resilient fish. The Blue Marlin is considered a prize by even the most experienced fishermen. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using worms.

items.name: Blue Spotted Ray
items.description: A colorful stingray with bright blue spots across its body and blue stripes along its tail. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using glow worms in the morning, day, and evening.

items.name: Bluefin Tuna
items.description: A common, sleek fish adapted for swimming quickly through ocean currents. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using worms.

items.name: Bronze Bluegill
items.description: Just like the Orange Bluegill, this fish has nary a spot of blue to be seen- not even its gills!

items.name: Cactus Moray
items.description: An eel with sharp spines growing along its length to deter predators. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using glow worms in the day and night.

items.name: Calico Koi
items.description: A standard koi fish with a beautiful calico pattern. Found in ponds without using any bait.

items.name: Cantankerous Koi
items.description: Local legend has it that the first Cantankerous Koi was a cranky old man transfigured by a wicked witch. Found in ponds without using any bait during the day and at night.

items.name: Channel Catfish
items.description: A river catfish at home navigating fast currents. Found in Kilima Rivers without bait.

items.name: Charged Cardinal
items.description: The charged cardinal can swim dozens of leagues without tiring, which is probably how it ended up here. Found in the Royal Highlands' bay.

items.name: Chub
items.description: A hard-fighting fish famous for its wide ranging appetite. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Cloudfish
items.description: A bottom feeding pondfish that can create swirling clouds of sediment for cover. Found in ponds using glow worms in the morning and day.

items.name: Copper Sturgeon
items.description: The Copper Sturgeon is born a brilliantly shiny orange, which slowly shifts to green as it ages. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highlands.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Crimson Fangtooth
items.description: A small red fish with huge teeth in proportion to its own size. Found in Bahari Bay caves using glow worms.

items.name: Crucian Carp
items.description: A hardy carp with coppery golden scales. Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Cutthroat Trout
items.description: A river trout named after its long jaw and mouth. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms.

items.name: Dart Eel
items.description: Known both for its slippery movements and its venomous bite, the Dart Eel is best avoided by all but the most adventurous of fishers. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highlands at night.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Dawnray
items.description: A golden ray that hunts at dawn, its scales absorbing the sun's light. Found in Bahari Rivers without bait in the morning from 3 AM to 6 AM.

items.name: Devilfish
items.description: Actually not that bad a guy.

items.name: Duskray
items.description: A mottled charcoal ray that hunts at dusk, blending into the riverbed. Found in Bahari Rivers without bait in the evening.

items.name: Eleroo Eel
items.description: Affectionately named for its sizable snout, and not for what it eats. Still, you might want to keep your eleroos at a distance.

items.name: Enchanted Pupfish
items.description: A cute little fish which can absorb trace amounts of Flow into its scales. Found in Kilima Lake using glow worms.

items.name: Energized Piranha
items.description: A piranha infused with magic after consuming a Grimalkin magic trinket. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms.

items.name: Enfield Eel
items.description: Was the family named for the eel, or the eel for the family? (It was the second one.)
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Eyeless Minnow
items.description: A cave dwelling creature that has lost the need for eyes. Found in Bahari Bay caves without bait.

items.name: Fairy Carp
items.description: A shy fish with a hypnotically translucent sheen. Found in ponds using worms in the mornings and evenings.

items.name: Fairy Manta
items.description: It is imperative you do not mix this up with the Fairy Mantis, especially when decorating their tanks. Found in the Royal Highland's bay during the day.

items.name: Fathead Minnow
items.description: A small freshwater fish known for its oversized head. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Flametongue Ray
items.description: A rare river ray named for the bright orange and red streaks across its back. Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms in the morning and day.

items.name: Freshwater Eel
items.description: A long and lithe river fish often confused for a snake. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms in the evening and night.

items.name: Giant Goldfish
items.description: Against all odds, some goldfish live to become legendary in size. Found in ponds using glow worms.

items.name: Giant Kilima Stingray
items.description: The lord of Kilima Lake, this stingray's poisonous spike can also pierce the bones of its prey. Found in Kilima Lake using glow worms in the morning, day, and evening.

items.name: Gillyfin
items.description: The most common fish in Palia. Found in Kilima Lake without using bait.

items.name: Golden Salmon
items.description: A common sort of salmon known to thrive in the sunlight. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms in the morning and day.

items.name: Green Anchovy
items.description: Somehow saltier than its less green cousin.

items.name: Heather Manta
items.description: This species often bullies the other fish in the lake. Really makes you wonder what its damage is.

items.name: Highland Floatfish
items.description: These floatfish were headed to the Elderwood when they took a wrong turn, and now they're too embarrassed to leave.

items.name: Highland Shark
items.description: A strange hybrid variant of the Lake Shark, this creature is unique to the Highlands and likely the result of intentional breeding.

items.name: Highland Sturgeon
items.description: Once this sturgeon's eggs were highly prized for caviar among Ancient Human nobility. Millenia left unbothered has made its populatioin explode, and its price to drop.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Highland Swiftscale
items.description: The early bird gets the worm, the second shrimprunt gets the cheese, and the Highland Swiftscale eats them both. Found in the Royal Highlands bay.

items.name: Honey Loach
items.description: A river fish whose yellow and black stripes resemble a honeybee. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms at day and night.

items.name: Hypnotic Moray
items.description: A moray eel that combines its striking pattern and hypnotic movements to lure in prey. Found in caves using glow worms.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Indigo Lamprey
items.description: Palians in the past would harvest the scales of this fish to make a deep indigo dye. Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms in the evening and night.

items.name: Inyrevn Mermaid
items.description: Murmurs of a mermaid in the water brought curious fishers from across Bahari Island to these woods in hopes they could catch sight of such a majestic creature. The Inyrevn Mermaid is likely not what they pictured.

items.name: Jade Koi
items.description: The Enfields heard about Ancient Humans breeding their own koi and figured they could do one better. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highlands.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Kenli's Carp
items.description: Kenli personally discovered this carp near Kilima Village. Bears a remarkable resemblance to a Crucian Carp... Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Kestra Eel
items.description: Named for the river in which it is found, the Kestra Eel is unusually docile for its species, often interrupting conflicts among other eels. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highland at night.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Kilima Catfish
items.description: A unique type of catfish found only in the Kilima Valley. Found in ponds using worms.

items.name: Kilima Grayling
items.description: A streamlined fish that spends the first part of its life at sea before returning to the rivers of the Kilima Valley. Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Kilima Redfin
items.description: An aggressive river predator that will eat literally anything. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms.

items.name: Lake Shark
items.description: Just when you thought the lakes were safe...

items.name: Largemouth Bass
items.description: A very talkative bass that can swallow creatures over 50% their own body weight. Found in Kilima Lake using worms.

items.name: Lesser Snakehead
items.description: Dreams of one day becoming greater.

items.name: Long Nosed Unicorn Fish
items.description: The horn of the unicorn fish is valuable to any alchemist or potion master. But beware, they are rumored to have psychic abilities that can make even the most accomplished fisherman think left is right. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using glow worms during the day.

items.name: Majiri-of-War
items.description: A mythological floatfish said to be attracted to areas associated with great strife.

items.name: Major Manta
items.description: Named after the patriarch of the Enfield family, who had a special fondness for breeding the creatures. Found in the Royal Highland's bay during the day.

items.name: Maws
items.description: There's a shark in the Elderwood, they say, with eyes as black as the void, like a potato pod's eyes. Maws, they call him, and by the time you see him coming, it's too late.

items.name: Midnight Floatfish
items.description: This floatfish emerges in the dark of night to feed on the nightmares of little children who don't eat their veggies- or so the old Umbraan tale goes.

items.name: Midnight Paddlefish
items.description: A rare paddlefish that feeds at night, its dark scales keeping it hidden from predators. Found in Kilima Lake using glow worms at night.

items.name: Mini Mullet
items.description: A controversial fish both despised and beloved across Palia.

items.name: Mirror Carp
items.description: A silvery carp with scales resembling mirrors. Found in ponds using worms.

items.name: Mossyfin
items.description: The Mossyfin will hide among the mossy rocks at the bottom of pools to camouflage itself. Unfortunately the bright pink stripes on its fins mean this is mostly pointless.

items.name: Mottled Gobi
items.description: An under appreciated fish that feeds on excess pond algae. Found in ponds using glow worms.

items.name: Muddy Manta
items.description: The manta is not native to the Vieuxport Sea, but no one's told the Muddy Manta that. Found in the Royal Highlands' bay during the day.

items.name: Mudminnow
items.description: A common minnow known for its muddy looking color. Found in ponds without using any bait.

items.name: Mutated Angler
items.description: A terrifying monstrosity, said to be a survivor from the time of humans. Found in Bahari Bay caves using worms.

items.name: Oily Anchovy
items.description: A slimy fish some Majiri find strangely appetizing. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms.

items.name: Ooh Barracuda
items.description: So named for Dr. Anna Ooh, a famous ichthyologist who studied the unique marine life of the Royal Highlands pre-Unification. Found in the Royal Highlands bay.

items.name: Orange Bluegill
items.description: An omnivorous fish that prefers insects but will eat anything it can fit into its mouth. Found in ponds using worms.

items.name: Paddlefish
items.description: A primitive fish that has survived for millions of years. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms.

items.name: Painted Perch
items.description: A petite river fish known for its pleasing colors. Found in Kilima Lake using worms.

items.name: Palian Betta
items.description: The Palian Betta is known for its solitary nature and tendency to fight others of its own kind. Unsurprisingly, the Palian Betta was named by Umbraans.

items.name: Piksii Floatfish
items.description: The Piksii of the Elderwood can come in all shapes and sizes. This one, for example, comes in the shape and size of a floatfish.

items.name: Platinum Chad
items.description: The brilliant platinum scales of this chad can fool fishermen into dreams of wealth. Found in Kilima rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Prism Trout
items.description: A gorgeous trout that shines like rainbows in the sunlight. Found in Kilima Lake using worms in the morning and day.

items.name: Radiant Sunfish
items.description: A beautifully radiant river fish that emits a blinding ray of light many compare to looking directly into the sun. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms.

items.name: Ragdoll Sturgeon
items.description: Known to flop like a ragdoll when held, leading to a confusing experience for the fish AND the fisher. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highland.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Rainbow Trout
items.description: A river fish sporting a muted multicolor scale pattern. Not smart enough to be jealous of the Prism Trout. Found in Kilima Rivers without bait.

items.name: Red-bellied Piranha
items.description: An aggressive river predator that will eat literally anything. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms.

items.name: Ribbontail Ray
items.description: Known to frequent tropical waters, the Ribbontail Ray recently made a surprising migration from the isles of Inyrevn to the west coast of the Palian Republic. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using worms in the morning and evening.

items.name: Rosy Bitterling
items.description: A freshwater fish with a rosy patch on its behind. Found in Bahari Rivers without bait.

items.name: Royal Betta
items.description: Royal Betta demands three times as much territory as other betta, but rarely defends it themselves. This often leads to days long standoffs, until one of them gets tired and swims off to find a bigger pond. Found in the rivers and ponds of the Royal Highlands.
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Sabertoothed Anchovy
items.description: An anchovy with teeth so sharp it might eat YOU for dinner.

items.name: Sardine
items.description: A small, but quick foraging fish that many Majiri enjoy eating when pickled. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay without bait.

items.name: Scarlet Koi
items.description: A sleek koi fish with a deep red pattern. Found in ponds using glow worms.

items.name: Shimmerfin
items.description: A mysterious fish that can sometimes be in two places at once. Found in Kilima Lake using worms.

items.name: Sillyfin
items.description: Come on, why don't you release them? They're just a silly little guy! They've done nothing wrong!
tags: Location: Royal Highlands Rivers and Ponds

items.name: Silver Salmon
items.description: A common silvery fish. Found in Kilima Rivers without bait in evenings and nights.

items.name: Silvery Minnow
items.description: A common minnow with silvery scales that sparkle in the sun. Found in Bahari Bay rivers without bait.

items.name: Smallmouth Bass
items.description: A common bass with very little to say that is known to occasionally leap from the water. Found in Kilima Lake using worms.

items.name: Spotted Bullhead
items.description: A bullhead with a spotted pattern. Found in Kilima Rivers without bait.

items.name: Stalking Catfish
items.description: A predatory blue catfish that will attack nearby vulnerable fish. Found in ponds using glow worms in the evening and night.

items.name: Starry Bitterling
items.description: It's said all the Elderwood's stars are in its waters, for its canopy blocks out the sky.

items.name: Stickleback
items.description: A carnivorous fish that enjoys feasting on roe, insects, crustaceans, and the toes of fisherman. Found in Kilima Rivers using worms in the morning and day.

items.name: Stonefish
items.description: Extremely poisonous, Stonefish naturally blend into their surroundings while waiting for prey. Found in caves using glow worms.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Stormray
items.description: A majestic river ray that hunts by twisting water currents and channeling lightning through its tail. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms in the morning and evening.

items.name: Striped Dace
items.description: A dace with a striped pattern down its back. Found in Kilima Rivers without bait.

items.name: Striped Sturgeon
items.description: A bottom feeding lake fish with light colored stripes that allow it to camouflage in the sunlight. Found in Kilima Lake using worms in the evening and night.

items.name: Swordfin Eel
items.description: An apex predator eel that uses its own body to cut down prey. Found in Bahari rivers using glow worms.

items.name: Thundering Eel
items.description: An electrically charged eel that can shock its prey into submission. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms.

items.name: Tinfin
items.description: A somewhat paranoid cousin of the Kilima Gillyfin.

items.name: Toadstool Floatfish
items.description: One touch of this floatfish's tentacles will induce mild hallucinations in its victim. You don't want to know what two touches does.

items.name: Turn Pike
items.description: This fish can go from 0-60 in the blink of an eye and complete a 90 degree turn at full speed.

items.name: Umbraan Betta
items.description: Unlike its Palian cousin, the Umbraan Betta can tolerate and even thrive in the presence of other Umbraan Betta.

items.name: Umbran Carp
items.description: A relative of the Fairy Carp, the Umbran Carp prefers the dark environments of caves and underground lake systems. Found in caves without bait.

items.name: Void Ray
items.description: Alien and terrifying, some say the Void Ray can enter the Echo realm and feed off smaller echoes is finds. Found in caves using glow worms.

items.name: Willow Lamprey
items.description: A long, thin lamprey named after its similarity to the branches of a willow tree. Found in Bahari Bay rivers using worms at night.

items.name: Yellow Perch
items.description: A common perch found in rivers. Found in Bahari Rivers without bait.

items.name: Yellowfin Tuna
items.description: A large tuna that can swim faster than its size implies. Found off the coast of Bahari Bay using glow worms.
